# 03_Modules/Transactions/src/module/module

## Classes

### TransactionsModule

Defined in: [03_Modules/Transactions/src/module/module.ts:63](https://github.com/citrineos/citrineos-core/blob/def27d2c18695e68d1cb53d23c8d4cfb26151d5f/03_Modules/Transactions/src/module/module.ts#L63)

Component that handles transaction related messages.

#### Extends

- `AbstractModule`

#### Constructors

##### Constructor

```ts
new TransactionsModule(
   config,
   cache?,
   fileStorage?,
   sender?,
   handler?,
   logger?,
   ocppValidator?,
   transactionEventRepository?,
   authorizeRepository?,
   deviceModelRepository?,
   componentRepository?,
   locationRepository?,
   tariffRepository?,
   reservationRepository?,
   ocppMessageRepository?,
   realTimeAuthorizer?,
   authorizers?): TransactionsModule;
```

Defined in: [03_Modules/Transactions/src/module/module.ts:156](https://github.com/citrineos/citrineos-core/blob/def27d2c18695e68d1cb53d23c8d4cfb26151d5f/03_Modules/Transactions/src/module/module.ts#L156)

This is the constructor function that initializes the [TransactionsModule](#transactionsmodule).

###### Parameters

| Parameter                     | Type                            | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `config`                      | `object` & `object`             | The `config` contains configuration settings for the module.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `cache?`                      | `ICache`                        | The cache instance which is shared among the modules & Central System to pass information such as blacklisted actions or boot status.                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `fileStorage?`                | `IFileStorage`                  | The `fileStorage` allows access to the configured file storage.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `sender?`                     | `IMessageSender`                | The `sender` parameter is an optional parameter that represents an instance of the IMessageSender interface. It is used to send messages from the central system to external systems or devices. If no `sender` is provided, a default RabbitMqSender instance is created and used.                            |
| `handler?`                    | `IMessageHandler`               | The `handler` parameter is an optional parameter that represents an instance of the IMessageHandler interface. It is used to handle incoming messages and dispatch them to the appropriate methods or functions. If no `handler` is provided, a default RabbitMqReceiver instance is created and used.         |
| `logger?`                     | `Logger`\<`ILogObj`\>           | The `logger` parameter is an optional parameter that represents an instance of Logger\<ILogObj\>. It is used to propagate system-wide logger settings and will serve as the parent logger for any sub-component logging. If no `logger` is provided, a default Logger\<ILogObj\> instance is created and used. |
| `ocppValidator?`              | `OCPPValidator`                 | -                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `transactionEventRepository?` | `ITransactionEventRepository`   | An optional parameter of type ITransactionEventRepository which represents a repository for accessing and manipulating transaction event data. If no `transactionEventRepository` is provided, a default sequelize:transactionEventRepository instance is created and used.                                    |
| `authorizeRepository?`        | `IAuthorizationRepository`      | An optional parameter of type IAuthorizationRepository which represents a repository for accessing and manipulating authorization data. If no `authorizeRepository` is provided, a default sequelize:authorizeRepository instance is created and used.                                                         |
| `deviceModelRepository?`      | `IDeviceModelRepository`        | An optional parameter of type IDeviceModelRepository which represents a repository for accessing and manipulating variable attribute data. If no `deviceModelRepository` is provided, a default sequelize:deviceModelRepository instance is created and used.                                                  |
| `componentRepository?`        | `CrudRepository`\<`Component`\> | An optional parameter of type CrudRepository\<Component\> which represents a repository for accessing and manipulating component data. If no `componentRepository` is provided, a default sequelize:componentRepository instance is created and used.                                                          |
| `locationRepository?`         | `ILocationRepository`           | An optional parameter of type ILocationRepository which represents a repository for accessing and manipulating location and charging station data. If no `locationRepository` is provided, a default sequelize:locationRepository instance is created and used.                                                |
| `tariffRepository?`           | `ITariffRepository`             | An optional parameter of type ITariffRepository which represents a repository for accessing and manipulating tariff data. If no `tariffRepository` is provided, a default sequelize:tariffRepository instance is created and used.                                                                             |
| `reservationRepository?`      | `IReservationRepository`        | An optional parameter of type IReservationRepository which represents a repository for accessing and manipulating reservation data. If no `reservationRepository` is provided, a default sequelize:reservationRepository instance is created and used.                                                         |
| `ocppMessageRepository?`      | `IOCPPMessageRepository`        | An optional parameter of type IOCPPMessageRepository which represents a repository for accessing and manipulating OCPP Message data. If no `ocppMessageRepository` is provided, a default sequelize:ocppMessageRepository instance is created and used.                                                        |
| `realTimeAuthorizer?`         | `IAuthorizer`                   | An optional parameter of type IAuthorizer which represents a real-time authorizer that can be used to authorize real-time requests.                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `authorizers?`                | `IAuthorizer`[]                 | An optional parameter of type IAuthorizer\[\] which represents a list of authorizers that can be used to authorize requests.                                                                                                                                                                                   |

[`TransactionsModule`](#transactionsmodule)

##### sendCall()

```ts
sendCall(
   stationId,
   tenantId,
   protocol,
   action,
   payload,
   callbackUrl?,
   correlationId?,
origin?): Promise<IMessageConfirmation>;
```

Defined in: 00_Base/dist/interfaces/modules/AbstractModule.d.ts:84

Sends a call with the specified identifier, tenantId, protocol, action, payload, and origin.

###### Parameters

| Parameter        | Type              | Description                                                      |
| ---------------- | ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `stationId`      | `string`          | The identifier of the station making the call.                   |
| `tenantId`       | `number`          | The identifier of the tenant.                                    |
| `protocol`       | `OCPPVersionType` | The subprotocol of the Websocket, i.e. "ocpp1.6" or "ocpp2.0.1". |
| `action`         | `CallAction`      | The action to be performed.                                      |
| `payload`        | `OcppRequest`     | The payload of the call.                                         |
| `callbackUrl?`   | `string`          | The callback URL for the call.                                   |
| `correlationId?` | `string`          | The correlation ID of the call.                                  |
| `origin?`        | `MessageOrigin`   | The origin of the call.                                          |

###### Returns

`Promise`\<`IMessageConfirmation`\>

A promise that resolves to the message confirmation.

###### Inherited from

```ts
AbstractModule.sendCall;
```
